name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 4 visits over 24 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 17 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 24 hours starting 2025-07-01, at wavelengths from 1.65 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
